name: milan_duomo
camera_ground_z_note: One scene-wide constant, which is a known weakness of the current code. It is the median topmost tile surface over a 6 by 6 m patch centred on the acquired panorama at ENU (1.025, 0.724) m, so it is the ellipsoidal height of the Piazza del Duomo pavement under that one camera and nothing else. Sampling spread over that patch is 0.032 m standard deviation, 0.122 m peak to peak. The same measurement reproduces Korenmarkt's shipped 50.837 m to within 0.033 m. Every future panorama in this scene inherits this single value, so any camera standing on the cathedral steps or on the Galleria threshold will start with a biased altitude.

geometry_selection.acquisition_radius_note: The downloader's region of interest is an ECEF ball centred on the ellipsoid, not on the terrain, so its horizontal reach at street level is sqrt(radius^2 - h^2) with h the site's ellipsoidal height. At h = 162.94 m a nominal 200 m radius reaches only 116 m horizontally and nothing above 200 m altitude. A 320 m radius reaches 275.4 m horizontally at pavement level and 114.2 m above ground at the 160 m ring, which covers the cathedral's 109 m spire.
geometry_selection.coverage_acceptance: At least 99% of the 200 m projection in each validation view

geometry_note: Standalone ENU support mesh. Inhouse triangulation supplies first-hit depth only. Semantic boundary resolution comes from the source image pixels.
